pattern: SVG funnel chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "funnel chart") of role="img" stage bars with roving focus; data table fallback (native table: Stage, Value, Of first stage, Of previous stage).

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription (localized "funnel chart"), named by the title
img with an aria-label: stage name, formatted value, and conversion from the first and previous stage
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers; wide tables scroll in a focusable region

roles.element: connectors, stage names and values beside the funnel, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id

First stage: "{label}: {value}"; later stages: "{label}: {value}, {ofFirst} of {first}, {ofPrevious} of previous stage" (for example "Cart: 400, 40% of Visits, 40% of previous stage"); missing: "{label}: No value"
0 on exactly one stage (roving); other stages have none
Table open state and the table region id

keyboard.action: Ten stages back / forward (clamped to the first / last).
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
One tab stop for the plot (the active stage), then the Show data table button and table region.

focus: Roving focus: one stage is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited stage (by id), also across re-renders (resize, update). Toggling the table keeps focus on the table button.
notes: Each stage name reads its value and its conversion from the first and the previous stage; the data table lists the same conversions.

The generated summary names the stage count, the first and last stage with values, the overall conversion, and the largest drop between consecutive stages (for example "Largest drop: Cart to Paid (25% kept).").
Meaning never depends on color: bar width, position, and printed names and values carry the data; per-stage colors are optional decoration.
Forced colors: bars keep a Canvas separator, connectors use GrayText, names CanvasText; focus and hover use Highlight.
No animation: nothing moves on render; hover and focus emphasis transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
